notes.title: Towards The Pantheon is OUT NOW on Steam!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/3648878e5eaedca57b436039ec89c8cb36046753.gif

Towards The Pantheon is OUT NOW on Steam! 

Now that you've played Towards The Pantheon: Escaping Eternity, Join Freyja, Bam, Mishima, and Phenez on their journey Towards The Pantheon! Gone are the RPG cliches of potions and elemental powers; in Towards The Pantheon you dive head first into a simultaneously lighthearted, fun, dark, and painful adventure in this fresh and exciting world! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/298644845a5fbde82627627b3464a2b922395a28.gif

Towards The Pantheon is a turn based 2D RPG with unique twists on the classic formula. Buy the game now to ride hamsters, journey through a survival horror inspired mansion, collect dead memories, eat copious amounts of sushi, and partake in regular chats around the campfire!

Features include:


Over 10 hours of gameplay including sidequests and myriads of secrets.
Unlockable NewGame+ mode and cheat codes for additional replay value.
Ability to switch between party members in the overworld to use their unique mechanics.
An eclectic original soundtrack consisting of over 65 songs which incorporate elements from orchestral, noise, drone, breakbeat, and chiptune genres.
A massive fully connected overworld with the ability to ride Speedsters to cut down on backtracking.
Turn based combat system where each character has unique battle stats and mechanics.
Collectible cards and combos found throughout the world that can be used during battle.
More than 10 regions to explore including lush forests, cities full of kitties, electropunk metropolises, barren wastelands, and a dark mysterious mansion.
Dialog and support systems that allow for further character development and stat boosts.
A unique and complex overarching story line that ties together all subplots and backstories.
Over 45 unique enemies and a dozen boss battles.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/640380e30c03a9ece91207f410ce324628309ef4.gif

We hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Towards The Pantheon releases May 16th! Add it to your Wishlist!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/d29d8030a680fb1ae6574e107f8bc6264157e9db.png

Hey everybody! Thank you all for checking out the short prequel game Towards The Pantheon: Escaping Eternity. On May 16th, the full length 2D RPG Towards The Pantheon will be releasing here on Steam!

Click here to check out the Steam page for it and add it to your wishlist! Be sure to do so if you want to be notified when the game releases. Here's some info from the Steam page!

A group known as The Sworn Light have slowly been gaining power throughout the world through divide and conquer tactics. While the humans, felines, electropunks, and ghosts begin to argue amongst themselves, The Sworn Light are taking advantage of each situation in order to ultimately take control. One day a small village chief named Wuotan summons his strongest warrior Freyja to embark on a long and dangerous journey. Her mission is to trek towards The Pantheon to defeat the source of The Sworn Light before the world falls into chaos. Along the way Freyja will battle deadly enemies, encountered long forgotten horrors, and make new friends!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/3648878e5eaedca57b436039ec89c8cb36046753.gif

Towards The Pantheon is a turn based 2D RPG with unique twists on the classic formula. Gone are genre standards of elemental types, elixirs, elves, inns, and generic love stories. Instead players of Towards The Pantheon will ride hamsters, journey through a survival horror inspired mansion, collect dead memories, and partake in regular chats around the campfire.

Features include:

Unlockable NewGame+ and cheat codes for additional replay value
Ability to switch between party members in the overworld as each have unique mechanics.
An eclectic original soundtrack consisting of over 80 tracks.
A massive fully connected overworld with a transportation system to cut down on unnecessary backtracking.
Turn based combat system where each character has unique battle stats and mechanics.
Collectible cards and combos found throughout the world that can be used during battle.
More than 10 regions to explore including lush forests, cities full of cats, dark electropunk metropolises, barren wastelands, and a dark and dangerous mansion.
Dialog and support systems that allow for further character development and stat boosts.
A unique and complex overarching story line that ties together all subplots and backstories.
Over 45 unique enemies spanning all regions.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/59ccddf41b1f38fea067c58b3c56d5f3a7a55961.png

Development of Towards The Pantheon began in 2016 when lead developer Connor O.R.T. Linning read a list of RPG cliches and decided to design a game that would avoid as many as possible. Soon afterwards Leandro Tokarevski joined in to create the pixel art using a palette of only 16 colors resulting in a vibrant and distinct world full of charm. Towards The Pantheon is the result of big dreams and two grueling years of hard work.

Thanks for reading, and I look forward to hearing what you think of Towards The Pantheon very soon!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/640380e30c03a9ece91207f410ce324628309ef4.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/44bcb9322270e361be32ad444e09233107af51ad.gif
